entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JsonPatch PocoAdapter TryTest incorrectly formats the current value on error. #70705
  • [Flakiness] CircuitRegistry reconnect leaves an evicted circuit registered #70699
  • [Flakiness] H2Spec parameterized test fails without retained case details #70698

  • Validate leading URI scheme and normalize relative paths at sink in URL Rewrite middleware #70695
  • QuickGrid regression in .NET 11: placeholders stay after text resize and ItemsProvider is not called #70694
  • ANCM out-of-process: duplicated `MS-ASPNETCORE-WINAUTHTOKEN` handle is not closed when the request never reaches `IISMiddleware` #70693
    Backlog
  • JwtBearer PACKAGE.md claims support for .NET Core 3.0+ and .NET Standard 2.1 #70690

Closed

  • Request Delegate Generator returns HTTP 500 instead of 400 for failed form antiforgery validation (.NET 10 and 11 RC3) #70229
    .NET 12 Planning
  • Untagged submodules #70657
  • CacheView: second and later requests return HTTP 500 when a cached child declares @rendermode on its own type #70330
    Backlog
